[[a]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_the_verified_oldest_people#cite_note-1) The oldest person ever whose age has been independently verified is [Jeanne Calment](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jeanne_Calment) (1875–1997) of France, who lived to the age of 122 years and 164 days. [[b]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_the_verified_oldest_people#cite_note-Calment-6) The oldest verified man ever is [Jiroemon Kimura](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jiroemon_Kimura) (1897–2013) of Japan, who lived to the age of 116 years and 54 days. web.description: The oldest living person is Ethel Caterham (UK, b. 21 August 1909), who is 116 years 223 days old, as verified by LongeviQuest on 1 April 2026.

web.title: Who is the oldest person in the world in 2024?
web.description:
# This is the oldest person in the world alive today
The verifiably oldest ever person in the world is **Jeanne Louise Calment**, who lived to the age of 122 years and 164 days old.

Today, the oldest person alive (as of August 2025), is the UK's Ethel Caterham. She is a sprightly 116 years, an age well beyond the average life expectancy of a human.

## Who is the oldest person alive today?
The oldest living person as of August 2025 is Ethel Caterham. She is 116 years old.

## Previous title holders
### Jeanne Louise Calment - Oldest person ever
![Jeanne Calment](https://c02.purpledshub.com/uploads/sites/41/2023/05/oldest-person-8b983f0.jpg?webp=1&w=1200)120-year-old Jeanne Louise Calment sitting in armchair at home © Ian Cook/Getty Images

Jeanne Louise Calment is the oldest verified person to have ever lived. The Frenchwoman lived to the ripe old age of 122 years and 164 days old. She was born on 21 February 1875 and passed away aged 122 on 4 August 1997.

### Lucile Randon - 118
Another Frenchwoman, Lucile Randon (see main picture) lived to the age of 118 years and 340 days old. Born on 11 February 1904, she passed away on 17 January 2023.

### Kane Tanaka - 119
Born on 2 January 1903 and passing away on 19 April 2022, the Japanese woman lived to be 119 years and 107 days old.

### Chiyo Miyako - 117
Another Japanese woman, Chiyo Miyako was born on 2 May 1901 and died on 22 July 2018, living up to the ripe age of 117 years and 81 days old.

### Nabi Tajima - 117
![Nabi Tajima](https://c02.purpledshub.com/uploads/sites/41/2023/05/oldest-person-c1af409.jpg?webp=1&w=1200)117-year-old Nabi Tajima © JIJI PRESS/AFP via Getty Images

Yet another Japanese supercentenarian, Nabi Tajima lived to be 117 years and 260 days old, from her birth on 4 August 1900 to her death on 21 April 2018.

### Violet Brown - 117
She lived to be 117 years and 189 days old.

### Emma Martina Luigia Morano - 117
Next is Emma Martina Luigia Morano. The Italian supercentenarian also lived to be 117 years old (plus 137 days) and was born on 29 November 1899 before her death on 15 April 2017.

### Susannah Mushatt Jones - 116
She lived to be 116 years and 311 days old and was born on 6 July 1899 and died on 12 May 2016.
